daily_scan.notes: Tuesday scan. No daily scan ran Monday 2026-10-12 and no weekly sweep ran Sunday 2026-10-11 (scheduler gap, not this session's doing) -- window_start is therefore Friday's daily_scan (2026-10-09T06:04:01+09:00), so this run's freshness window reaches back across Friday, the weekend and Monday (~4 days), per the skill's window-is-the-last-real-run mechanism. digest_carryover was already null at the start of this run (no weekly sweep logged anything to carry). Of the 48 umbrellas: 18 Sunday-only umbrellas (stage_label 'Approved / marketed' with molecule_class exactly ['non_incretin'] -- the admin's 2026-09-29 rule) skipped unconditionally, counted as throttled. All remaining 30 were due -- every one had last_checked 2026-10-08 or 2026-10-09 (4-5 days before today), past the throttle's 2-day grace window regardless of days-since-last_updated -- and were queried on their single most distinctive alias. One new finding: cspc-syh2082 -- a March 20, 2026 CSPC HKEX announcement (Tier 1, confirmed) disclosing NMPA China clinical-trial approval for SYH2082, a distinct regulatory event not previously captured alongside the already-known Feb 2026 FDA clearance; logged as f-2026-03-20-001, dated outside the freshness window so flagged discovered-late, current_status.last_updated left at 2026-04-13 (the more recent known event) rather than regressed. Bostal Drug Delivery (bostal-b2227): BIO conference program listings and a Pharmacodia database entry describe additional once-monthly-or-bimonthly semaglutide-LAI and brexpiprazole-LAI pipeline programs beyond B2227, but both sources are Tier 3, carry no confirmable date, and conflict with each other on dosing interval (monthly per a 2025 listing vs bimonthly per a 2024 one) -- too thin/inconsistent to log as a finding; noted here instead, worth re-checking if a dated, better-sourced mention turns up. All other 28 due umbrellas reconfirmed existing documentation with no new findings. Track B1: all 14 fixed watchlist rows queried (En/Kr per class plus cross-class and other_incretin rows) -- every result resolved to an already-tracked program (CSPC SYH2082/SYH9017/SYH-2092, Peptron PT403/PT404, Nanexa PharmaShell/NEX-22, Daewoong/TionLab Quject, Owl Bio/Kyungdong AUL009/AUL018, G2GBio InnoLAMP, InventageLab IVL3003/3008/3016/3021/3024, Metsera MET-097i/MET-233i, Novo Nordisk Zenagamtide, Mapi Pharma semaglutide/GA Depot, Proteina PRT-1309, Lilly eloralintide) or an off-scope/too-thin mention (Novo Nordisk's NN1213 and NNC0174-0839 compound-sharing listings -- Tier 1 but no confirmed dosing interval and no dated event, so not logged; a 'Peptidron' US-patent mention that duplicates content already logged under Peptron's Sept 28/Oct 1 tirzepatide-patent finding, treated as the same event). Code harvest surfaced roughly 30 code-pattern strings (ASC30/35/36/37, AX251/AX251b, BICX104, B2227/BST-2227, CAM2056, SYH2082/SYH9017, DW-4321, DKF-MB501, GX-H9, HHK001, IVL3003/3008/3016/3021/3024, LY3841136, PT403/PT404, MET-097i/MET-233i/PF-08653944, PRT-1309, ZT002, GB-7001, NPM-139, ZP8396, NN1213, NNC0174-0839) -- all resolved to already-tracked aliases/candidates or known parent-molecule identifiers, except one unknown code: SYH-2092, a CSPC amylin-receptor agonist (Phase 1, NCT07776041, NMPA-cleared Aug 2026, fatty-acid-modified for extended half-life). Queried (2 searches, within the per-code budget) but its dosing interval could not be confirmed as once-monthly/long-acting -- one source explicitly flags that 'once-monthly' mentions near SYH-2092 may be conflating it with the confirmed-monthly SYH2082, and no source states a monthly or longer interval for SYH-2092 itself -- so it is not logged as a finding or candidate this run, same treatment as the existing ct-g32 rotation entry pending dosing-interval confirmation. codes_queried counts this one code (2 search attempts); no other unknown code met the bar for a bounded query. Rotation list: queried biote-cn121154792a, ct-g32, abbv-295 and pt404 (4 rows, resuming after cursor 'lilly-camurus' then wrapping to the start of the 5-row list) -- all four reconfirmed existing documentation with no new findings (CT-G32 still has no disclosed dosing interval, so it stays a 'watch' rotation entry, not a candidate; the ABBV-295 Phase 2 detail found -- NCT07752979, ~360 participants, week-32 endpoint -- corroborates rather than extends the evidence already on cand-2026-09-22-001, so no new evidence entry was appended). B3 cheap pass (2/2 searches spent): re-searched the 2 near_bar pending candidates tied at the oldest follow_up.last_checked date (2026-10-07), Alteogen ALT-M5 (cand-2026-09-18-001) and i2o Therapeutics (cand-2026-09-20-002) -- both reconfirmed only material already on file, no new dated event for either, promotion_bar.evidence rewritten on both, no status change; stamped follow-up 2026-10-13. Stall rule (free date math): two candidates newly stalled this run -- Appel Sauce Studios (cand-2026-09-11-001: 32 days past created_date, checks_run=10, no new evidence ever appended since creation, fuzzy_match 0) and Jiangsu Hengrui/Kailera (cand-2026-09-11-002: 32 days past created_date, checks_run=4, technical_claim never cleared since creation, fuzzy_match 0.22) -- both moved pending to stalled, neither a merge case. CSPC ZhongQi (cand-2026-09-02-007, fuzzy 0.58) and CSPC SYH9017 (cand-2026-09-13-002, fuzzy 0.60) remain mechanically stall-eligible by the same free-date-math test but stay unmoved as the already-flagged merge cases pending an admin merge/sibling-umbrella decision, unchanged from prior runs. No WebFetch calls were made this run (WebSearch only, per the skill's search tool), so source_health required no updates; clinicaltrials.gov was reached only through search results, not queried directly. Digest: one new finding this run (cspc-syh2082, discovered-late, outside the headline window) and no new candidates -- left for the renderer's delivery rule to decide.
